description: Put-away detail lost the operator's scroll position after removing a scan or removing a scan from a shelf — every reload flipped the page back to the loading state, which unmounted the whole item panel and reset scrollTop to the top of a long order
reproSteps: Open a put-away order with many part groups → expand a group, scroll down → press Remove scan (or Remove from shelf) → the page reloads and jumps back to the top, forcing the operator to scroll down again
remarks: Fixed in commit 1d432efa (11-09) — load() no longer sets pending=true on reloads (initial load still shows the loading state), so the panel stays mounted and scroll is preserved; retest in UAT
